devices.description: Physical block devices counted once. Loop and pseudo devices are excluded.

filesystems.description: Mounted filesystems from /proc/self/mountinfo joined with statfs. One filesystem can have several mounts.

volumes.description: All persistent partitions and logical volumes, including firmware, recovery, swap, and unknown signatures. Capacity is not inferred without a readable mount.

unmounted.description: Partitions and drives holding a filesystem, or a locked encrypted container, that nothing has mounted. System partitions (EFI, recovery, reserved, swap) are left out. Their usage is unknown until they are mounted.
